import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import * as T from 'three'
import {Game} from '../src/karakurt/game.js'
import {fresh} from '../src/karakurt/state.js'
const items=Object.fromEntries(['Carapace','Abdomen','Marking','Sofa','Table','Photograph','Guitar','Hammer','Books','Lamp','Slipper'].map(n=>[n,new T.Group()]))
function setup(){let writes=0;globalThis.localStorage={setItem(){writes++}};const model=new T.Group();model.add(new T.Mesh(new T.BoxGeometry(1,2,1)));const remy={scene:model,animations:['Idle','Walk','Run','Collision','Fall','Attack'].map(n=>new T.AnimationClip(n,1,[]))};let ended=null;const g=new Game(new T.Scene(),{items,remy},{toast(){},memory(){},end:won=>ended=won});return {g,writes:()=>writes,end:()=>ended}}
test('Menu does not erase saves; starting and crossing rooms saves explicitly',()=>{const {g,writes}=setup();assert.equal(writes(),0);g.start(fresh());assert.equal(writes(),1);g.enter(1);assert.equal(g.state.room,1);assert.equal(writes(),2)})
test('Door crossing occurs before the floor ends, with return travel',()=>{const {g}=setup();g.start(fresh());g.spider.reset(new T.Vector3(0,0,-7.7));for(let i=0;i<8&&g.state.room===0;i++)g.move(.016,{forward:1,strafe:0});assert.equal(g.state.room,2);g.spider.reset(new T.Vector3(0,0,7.7));for(let i=0;i<8&&g.state.room===2;i++)g.move(.016,{forward:-1,strafe:0});assert.equal(g.state.room,0)})
test('Side branches are traversable and return to the same spine room',()=>{const {g}=setup();g.start(fresh());g.spider.reset(new T.Vector3(9.65,0,0));for(let i=0;i<8&&g.state.room===0;i++)g.move(.016,{forward:0,strafe:1});assert.equal(g.state.room,1);g.spider.reset(new T.Vector3(-9.65,0,0));for(let i=0;i<8&&g.state.room===1;i++)g.move(.016,{forward:0,strafe:-1});assert.equal(g.state.room,0)})
test('Spider curls over a real box edge onto its side',()=>{const {g}=setup();g.start(fresh());const box=new T.Mesh(new T.BoxGeometry(2,1,2));box.position.y=.5;box.updateMatrixWorld(true);g.house.collision=[box];g.spider.reset(new T.Vector3(0,1.02,-.98));g.move(.04,{forward:1,strafe:0});assert.ok(g.spider.normal.z<-.9);assert.ok(g.spider.position.z<-1);assert.ok(g.spider.forward.y<-.9)})
test('Actual Game loop collects all memories and final requires artifact plus cocoon',()=>{const {g,end}=setup();g.start(fresh());for(let room=0;room<5;room++){g.enter(room);g.spider.position.copy(g.house.current.memory.mesh.position);g.update(.016,{forward:0,strafe:0});}assert.equal(g.state.memories.length,5);g.spider.position.set(-6,2.1,-5);g.action('interact');assert.equal(g.state.artifact,true);g.person.position.set(0,0,0);g.spider.reset(new T.Vector3(0,0,1));g.brain.stun=5;g.action('bite');assert.equal(g.state.status,'playing');g.state.cooldown=0;g.action('web');assert.equal(g.brain.cocooned,true);assert.equal(g.brain.attack,0);g.action('bite');assert.equal(g.state.status,'won');assert.equal(end(),true)})
test('Bank noise retains fixed source; unsupported motion rolls back instead of floating',()=>{const {g}=setup();g.start(fresh());g.enter(1);const jar=g.house.current.jars[0];g.spider.position.copy(jar.position);g.action('interact');assert.ok(g.noiseSource.distanceTo(jar.position)<1e-8);g.spider.position.set(0,4,0);const before=g.spider.position.clone();g.move(.016,{forward:1,strafe:0});assert.ok(g.spider.position.distanceTo(before)<1e-8)})

import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import * as T from 'three'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import {fresh,remember,damage,save,restore,perception} from '../src/karakurt/state.js'
import {describeRoom,House} from '../src/karakurt/rooms.js'
import {twoBoneKnee} from '../src/karakurt/ik.js'
import {Karakurt} from '../src/karakurt/spider.js'
const items=Object.fromEntries(['Carapace','Abdomen','Marking','Sofa','Table','Photograph','Guitar','Hammer','Lamp','Books','Slipper'].map(n=>[n,new T.Group()]))
test('Analytic IK preserves both segment lengths for reachable targets',()=>{for(let i=1;i<100;i++){const a=new T.Vector3(),b=new T.Vector3(i/100,0,.1),k=twoBoneKnee(a,b,.55,.6,new T.Vector3(0,1,0));assert.ok(Math.abs(k.distanceTo(a)-.55)<1e-6);assert.ok(Math.abs(k.distanceTo(b)-.6)<1e-6)}})
test('Every foot takes visible world-space steps; rest does not drift',()=>{const s=new Karakurt(items),probe=o=>new T.Vector3(o.x,0,o.z);s.update(.016,false,probe);const feet=s.legs.map(l=>l.foot.clone());for(let i=0;i<120;i++)s.update(1/60,false,probe);s.legs.forEach((l,i)=>assert.ok(l.foot.distanceTo(feet[i])<1e-8));for(let i=0;i<180;i++){s.position.z-=.025;s.update(1/60,true,probe)}for(const l of s.legs){assert.ok(l.steps>3);assert.ok(l.foot.distanceTo(s.position)<1.5)}})
test('Streaming house stays bounded, seeded, connected and memories stay collected',()=>{const h=new House(new T.Scene(),items,7319);for(let id=0;id<30;id++){h.enter(id,[]);assert.ok(h.active.size<=4);assert.ok(h.created<=4);assert.deepEqual(describeRoom(7319,id),describeRoom(7319,id));for(const n of describeRoom(7319,id).neighbors)assert.ok(describeRoom(7319,n).neighbors.includes(id))}h.enter(0,[0]);assert.equal(h.current.memory,null);h.clear();assert.equal(h.active.size,0)})
test('Memory unlocks once; completed/dead saves are not revived',()=>{const s=fresh();assert.ok(remember(s,0));assert.equal(remember(s,0),null);let raw;const storage={setItem:(k,v)=>raw=v,getItem:()=>raw};s.elapsed=55;save(s,storage);assert.equal(restore(storage).elapsed,55);for(let i=0;i<5;i++){s.invincible=0;damage(s)}save(s,storage);assert.equal(restore(storage).status,'lost');assert.equal(restore(storage).health,0)})
test('Occluded target is not seen and pursuit forgets after four seconds',()=>{const b={mode:'Patrol',alert:0,lost:0};perception({distance:2,dot:1,occluded:true,noise:false,dt:1},b);assert.equal(b.mode,'Patrol');perception({distance:2,dot:1,occluded:false,noise:false,dt:1},b);assert.equal(b.mode,'Chase');for(let i=0;i<7;i++)perception({distance:10,dot:0,occluded:true,noise:false,dt:1},b);assert.equal(b.mode,'Patrol')})
test('Remy external export contains required clips and resolvable local textures',()=>{const base=new URL('../public/models/',import.meta.url),j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(new URL('remy-karakurt.gltf',base)));for(const n of ['Idle','Walk','Run','Attack','Collision','Fall'])assert.ok(j.animations.some(a=>a.name===n));for(const image of j.images)assert.ok(fs.existsSync(new URL(image.uri,base)));for(const b of j.buffers)assert.ok(fs.existsSync(new URL(b.uri,base)))})

# Каракурт: Возмездие — модели и источники

New procedural karakurt components, furniture, books, lamp, slipper, cushion seams and guitar strings: created in Blender for this project. Source: model/karakurt-production.blend; export: karakurt-atelier.glb. Procedural IK attribution: PROCEDURAL-SPIDER-LICENSE.txt.

Remy and animation FBX files: supplied by the user in model/persona (Mixamo-named rig). Original distribution rights have not been independently verified; confirm the source license before public distribution. Runtime export: remy-karakurt.gltf with remy-textures and binary buffer; Blender NLA tracks Idle, Walk, Run, Collision, Fall, plus authored Attack. Sources preserved.

# Spider with Animation (preserved original game)

Author: maksroberthut — https://sketchfab.com/maksroberthut
Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/spider-with-animation-ba8149ca471a4708bfdba07460450815
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Provided by the user as spider_with_animation_1k_texture.glb.
Changes: materials converted from specular/glossiness to metallic/roughness with glTF Transform. Runtime scale and placement adjusted for the game. Original animation retained. Blender-authored Walk (alternating eight-leg hip sweeps and foot lifts), TurnLeft and TurnRight (opposed leg stepping and hip sweeps) added in model/spider-animations.blend; exported as spider-animated.glb (preserved). Current game asset: spider-walker-ik.glb. Walk was replaced with a Spider Walker 1.0.6 bake through eight 3-bone IK chains, sampled to deform-bone transforms for Three.js. Editable copy and original scene: model/spider-walker-ik.blend. Source models unchanged. Additional Blender-authored Idle (abdomen breathing), Jump (leg tuck / landing compression), and WebCast (abdomen raise / silk contraction pulses) included.
